description: order-flow proxies per contract-month (see docs); accuracies joined from e0_what_changed.json (Q10 fresh-model diagonal)

run_mean.definition: mean length of maximal runs of same-sign events (sweeps not merged)
run_mean.mechanism: order splitting (metaorders): note ref 1 (Lillo, Mike, Farmer 2005), ref 2 (Toth et al. 2015), ref 3 (Sato, Kanazawa 2023); note s5.3, drivers table

run_share_ge10.definition: share of same-sign runs (sweeps not merged) with length >= 10
run_share_ge10.mechanism: order splitting (metaorders): note ref 1 (Lillo, Mike, Farmer 2005), ref 2 (Toth et al. 2015), ref 3 (Sato, Kanazawa 2023); note s5.3, drivers table

run_mean_sweeps_merged.definition: run_mean after merging each sweep (same sign, gap <= 1 ms) into one unit
run_mean_sweeps_merged.mechanism: order splitting (metaorders): note ref 1 (Lillo, Mike, Farmer 2005), ref 2 (Toth et al. 2015), ref 3 (Sato, Kanazawa 2023); note s5.3, drivers table

run_share_ge10_sweeps_merged.definition: share of runs with >= 10 units, sweeps merged
run_share_ge10_sweeps_merged.mechanism: order splitting (metaorders): note ref 1 (Lillo, Mike, Farmer 2005), ref 2 (Toth et al. 2015), ref 3 (Sato, Kanazawa 2023); note s5.3, drivers table

sweep_share.definition: share of events with the same sign as the previous event and <= 1 ms after it (absorbed when sweeps are merged)
sweep_share.mechanism: sweeps in aggregation: note ref 37 (Binance aggTrade definition); note s5.1

equal_size_repeat_share.definition: among consecutive event pairs of the same sign, share with identical qty (compared in whole lots)
equal_size_repeat_share.mechanism: fixed child sizes of slicing algorithms: note s5.4; order splitting (metaorders): note ref 1 (Lillo, Mike, Farmer 2005), ref 2 (Toth et al. 2015), ref 3 (Sato, Kanazawa 2023); note s5.3, drivers table

lot.definition: lot size detected from the qty grid (estimate_tick on event qty)

round_size_share.definition: share of events whose size in lots n has n >= 10 and one significant digit (10, 20, ..., 90, 100, 200, ... lots)
round_size_share.mechanism: human or bot round sizing: note s5.5, ref 31, ref 17; flow composition row of drivers table

round10_share.definition: share of events whose size is a multiple of 10 lots

share_gap_le_1ms.definition: share of events at most 1 ms after the previous event (any sign)
share_gap_le_1ms.mechanism: bot bursts and sweeps: note s5.1, s5.6

fano_1s.definition: variance / mean of event counts in 1 s bins from the first to the last event of the month (empty bins included); 1 for a Poisson stream
fano_1s.mechanism: burstiness (self-excitation, Hawkes): note section 1.2; clock-periodic bots: note ref 31 (arXiv 2607.09426); note s5.6, drivers table

minute_open_ratio.definition: share of events in second 0 of each minute, times 60
minute_open_ratio.mechanism: clock-periodic bots: note ref 31 (arXiv 2607.09426); note s5.6, drivers table

quarter_open_ratio.definition: share of events in second 0 of each quarter-hour (:00, :15, :30, :45), times 900
quarter_open_ratio.mechanism: clock-periodic bots: note ref 31 (arXiv 2607.09426); note s5.6, drivers table

median_notional_usd.definition: median of price * qty per event
median_notional_usd.mechanism: smaller trade sizes: note ref 15 (Kyle, Obizhaeva, Tuzun), ref 16 (O'Hara, Yao, Ye 2014); drivers table

share_under_1k_usd.definition: share of events with price * qty < 1000 USD
share_under_1k_usd.mechanism: smaller trade sizes: note ref 15 (Kyle, Obizhaeva, Tuzun), ref 16 (O'Hara, Yao, Ye 2014); drivers table

tick.definition: price tick in force: estimate_tick on the month's on-grid prices (raw aggTrade prices, or single-print event prices); the last day's tick if it changes within the month
tick.mechanism: larger relative tick: note section 4, ref 19 (Dayri, Rosenbaum 2015), ref 22 (Briola et al. 2025), Q4b; note s5.8, drivers table

tick_changes.definition: 1 if the per-day tick estimate is not the same on every day, else 0
tick_changes.mechanism: larger relative tick: note section 4, ref 19 (Dayri, Rosenbaum 2015), ref 22 (Briola et al. 2025), Q4b; note s5.8, drivers table

rel_tick_bps.definition: tick / median event price * 1e4; if the tick changes within the month, the event-weighted mean over days of tick_day / median price_day * 1e4
rel_tick_bps.mechanism: larger relative tick: note section 4, ref 19 (Dayri, Rosenbaum 2015), ref 22 (Briola et al. 2025), Q4b; note s5.8, drivers table

unchanged_price_share.definition: share of consecutive trades at the same price (raw aggTrade records in id order when raw is given, else events)
unchanged_price_share.mechanism: tick-bound book / queue depletion: note section 4 (a); larger relative tick: note section 4, ref 19 (Dayri, Rosenbaum 2015), ref 22 (Briola et al. 2025), Q4b; note s5.8, drivers table

prints_per_event.definition: raw aggTrade records per aggressor event (raw only)
prints_per_event.mechanism: aggregation shape (possible measurement artifact, README week 0): sweeps in aggregation: note ref 37 (Binance aggTrade definition); note s5.1

fills_per_record.definition: mean of last_trade_id - first_trade_id + 1 per aggTrade (raw only)
fills_per_record.mechanism: queue fragmentation / maker count: note s5.2; maker competition row of drivers table (ref 18, Eisler, Bouchaud, Kockelkoren 2012)

sign_repeat_rate.definition: share of events with the same sign as the previous event
sign_repeat_rate.mechanism: descriptive, near-circular: nearly the next-sign accuracy itself

sign_acf_lag1.definition: Pearson correlation of sign[t] and sign[t-1]
sign_acf_lag1.mechanism: descriptive, near-circular: nearly the next-sign accuracy itself
